acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing or using this ScholaFlow deployment ("the Service"), you agree to these Terms and Conditions and the <privacyLink>Privacy Policy</privacyLink>. If you do not agree with these terms, please do not use the platform.

description.title: About ScholaFlow
description.content: ScholaFlow is a self-hostable learning platform designed to help schools, instructors, and students organize classes, share study materials, turn in assignments, chat in real-time groups, track deadlines, and take notes.

eligibility.title: User Accounts and Access
items: Access is managed by the administrator, school, or organization hosting this deployment.
Users of any educational level may participate when authorized and supervised by their educational institution, instructor, or organization.
You agree to provide accurate and truthful information when creating your account.
You are responsible for keeping your login credentials confidential and secure.
Each account is intended for individual use; do not share your credentials with others.

roles.title: Student and Instructor Roles
items: Students: Can join classes via class codes, access coursework, submit assignments, participate in class chats, and organize personal notes.
Instructors: Can create and manage courses, publish announcements, assign homework, grade submissions, and moderate classroom discussions.
Classroom permissions: Instructors have the authority to decide whether students can post or comment on the class stream, and can remove users who disrupt the learning environment.

coursework.title: Assignments, Submissions, and Deadlines
items: Due dates: Instructors set deadlines and scoring rubrics. If an instructor enables due-date cutoff, late submissions will be blocked automatically.
Original work: Students must turn in their own work through the classwork tab. Graded assignments can be returned with feedback and scores.
Backups: While this deployment securely stores uploaded files, users are encouraged to maintain copies of their own original schoolwork.

communication.title: Classroom Discussions and Real-Time Chat
items: Respectful environment: Stream posts, assignment comments, and real-time chat rooms are meant for constructive learning. Harassment, profanity, and offensive language are strictly prohibited.
Public vs. private: Stream comments are visible to the entire class roster, while private comments on assignments are seen only by the student and their instructor.
Chat etiquette: Do not flood, spam, or disrupt live group chats.

notes.title: Personal Notes
notes.content: The personal notepad is a private workspace for students and teachers to keep study notes and attachments. These notes remain strictly private to your account and are never visible to classmates or instructors.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable Use Policy
acceptableUse.intro: To maintain a safe and productive educational environment, you agree not to:
items: Violate school policies, honor codes, or applicable laws.
Plagiarize, cheat, or submit another person's work as your own.
Bully, harass, threaten, or impersonate other students, teachers, or administrators.
Upload viruses, harmful files, or malicious scripts.
Attempt to bypass access controls or alter grades without authorization.
Send spam or unauthorized commercial solicitations.

content.title: Content Ownership and Rights
items: You retain full ownership of the original homework, notes, and study materials you create.
You grant this platform deployment permission to host, store, and display your coursework solely as needed to provide class features.
You confirm that files you upload do not infringe on others' copyright or intellectual property.

availability.title: Instance Availability and Maintenance
items: The hosting organization or administrator is responsible for maintaining the server, uptime, and backups for this deployment.
Temporary downtime may occur during server maintenance or software updates.
The software is provided to assist education, but uninterrupted operation cannot be guaranteed.

liability.title: Limitation of Liability
liability.content: ScholaFlow is provided "as is" as open-source, self-hostable educational software. The developers and instance administrators are not liable for any lost data, unsaved coursework, missed deadlines, or indirect damages arising from the use of the platform.

termination.title: Account Closure and Removal
items: You can close your account through account settings, which will delete your profile, personal notes, and private files.
Instance administrators or instructors may suspend or remove accounts that violate these terms or institutional policies.
Academic records and grades may be retained by the institution as required by school guidelines.

changes.title: Updates to Terms
changes.content: These terms may be updated from time to time by the deployment administrator. Continued use of the platform indicates acceptance of any revisions.

contact.title: Contact and Inquiries
contact.content: For support or questions regarding this deployment, reach out to your school administrator or contact the open-source project at <emailLink>scholaflow@gmail.com</emailLink> or <githubLink>open an issue on GitHub.</githubLink>
